notes: Target account generation can create matching checkout profiles and optionally jig shipping addresses.
Generated profiles now use the IMAP mailbox email from the generator, not the random catchall login.
Target generation can launch Chrome, Edge, Brave, or another installed browser instead of bundled Chromium.
The Add Account Tasks modal can select every unused Target account at once.
Settings shows the three newest cloud backups and keeps older ones behind a short list.
